value.rationale: The natural all-rate return-speed threshold resolves when physically costly regenerative returns can ever improve mean exit. It turns a local small-r diagnostic into a globally sharp feasibility criterion and provides an explicit finite-rate/weak-rate reversal in 2<A<4. It is structural, quantifier-sensitive and directly relevant to stochastic search optimization, not a trivial recomputation.
